downloadDescription: HPC Pack 2019 Update 3 provides enterprise-class tools, performance and scalability for a highly productive HPC environment either on premises, Hybrid or Azure Cloud.
detailsSection:
HPC Pack 2019 is a high performance computing (HPC) solution that combines a comprehensive set of deployment, administration, job scheduling, and monitoring tools for your HPC cluster environment, and a flexible platform for developing and running HPC applications. It delivers enterprise-class tools, performance and scalability for a highly productive HPC environment, providing an integrated cluster environment featuring the HPC Job Scheduler, Message Passing Interface (MPI) and Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA) interactive application support, cluster management and monitoring tools. HPC Pack 2019 also delivers cloud ready solutions for Hybrid and Cloud on Microsoft Azure.

HPC Pack 2019 Update 3 is the third update for HPC Pack 2019. Please check the 'What's New' and 'Release Notes' available on the Microsoft HPC Pack Documentations.
systemRequirementsSection:
HPC Pack 2019 Update 3 supported Operating Systems
  • Head nodes: Windows Server 2025, Windows Server 2022, Windows Server 2019, Windows Server 2016, Windows Server 2012 R2 (no support for SQL Express 2019 or 2022)
  • Compute nodes: Windows Server 2025, Windows Server 2022, Windows Server 2019, Windows Server 2016, Windows Server 2012 R2, Windows Server 2012
  • Broker nodes: Windows Server 2025, Windows Server 2022, Windows Server 2019, Windows Server 2016, Windows Server 2012 R2, Windows Server 2012
  • Workstation nodes: x86 or x64 versions of windows 10, windows 11
  • Unmanaged server nodes: Windows Server 2025, Windows Server 2022, Windows Server 2019, Windows Server 2016, Windows Server 2012 R2, Windows Server 2012
  • Linux Compute nodes: Red Hat Enterprise Linux 7.6 - 9.5, Ubuntu Server 16.04 LTS, Ubuntu Server 18.04 LTS, Ubuntu Server 20.04 LTS, Ubuntu Server 22.04 LTS, Ubuntu Server 24.04 LTS, Alma Linux 8.5 - 9.4, Rocky Linux 8.5 - 9.4, SUSE Linux Enterprise Server 12 - 15
  • Client: Windows Server 2025, Windows Server 2022, Windows Server 2019, Windows Server 2016, Windows Server 2012 R2, Windows Server 2012, Windows 11, Windows 10


    • Additional notes: CPU: x64 architecture computer, except for Workstation nodes which may run x86-based or x64-based processors
    RAM: 4GB
    Minimum disk space for setup: 50 GB
    Network interface card: At least one network interface card (NIC) is required. Additional NICs may be required depending on the selected network topology
installInstructionSection:
Prior to installation, please review the 'What's New' and 'Release Notes' available on the Microsoft HPC Pack Documentations.

o Slipstream installation:

Download the 'HPCPack2019Update3-Full-v8355.zip' file, extract the contents to the root of your drive and run 'setup.exe' to start the HPC Pack 2019 Update 3 installation wizard on a supported Windows Server based computer.

o Fix installation:

KB5081004
This QFE fixes some known issues of HPC Pack 2019 update 3 as described below.
- Web Portal Security Enhancement. Fixed insecure deserialization of the Web Portal job-list preferences cookie, preventing authenticated users from executing unauthorized code on the head node through specially crafted requests.
- Scheduler Communication Security Enhancement. Removed insecure BinaryFormatter deserialization from Scheduler WCF messages and replaced it with a controlled native identity serialization format, preventing specially crafted messages from executing code on the head node. Note Entra ID job authentication requires the patch on both client and server sides.
- Certificate Authentication Enhancement. Strengthened X.509 client certificate validation for the Scheduler and related HPC services. Access to protected internal services is now restricted to certificates matching the cluster configuration, preventing certificate-based identity spoofing and privilege escalation.

This QFE needs to be run on all cluster nodes. Before installation, please make sure the current version number (Start HPC Cluster Manager, click Help->About) is 6.3.8328.0 or 6.3.8352 or 6.3.8355.

Download and run ‘KB5124659_x64’ on all cluster nodes. HPC services will be automatically restarted with the patch. After patching, the server version is 6.3.8359.0 while the client version is still 6.3.8328.0. Note this patch cannot be uninstalled.
